General Adult

General Youth

(

Children under 5: FREE
2026 Twilight Admission, 3:00pm to 6:00pm entry, sales beginning November 1:
A great excuse to visit the Dickens Fair for a second time for shopping, dinner or a show!
Adult Twilight Ticket
 (entry after 3 pm): 
$35.00 
($41.04 total*)
Child Twilight Ticket
 (entry after 3 pm): 
$20.00 
($25.51 total*)
2026 Active Military Discount
Active Military:
 1st & 2nd Weekends 
FREE
 Admission
Active Military personnel along with three family members will receive FREE Admission on our First and Second Weekends!
(Nov. 21, 22, 27, 28, 29; photo I.D. required at Will Call.)
No reservation or ticket is required. Just go to the Will Call window with your active ID and they will assist you. Remember that children under 5 never need a ticket and do not count toward the 4 free tickets. Thank you and your family for your service.
The 2026 Pickwick Club Season Pass
Join the Pickwick Club and count yourself among the merriest of Christmas Keepers. With the purchase of a season pass you can become a member of this illustrious club. The 
2026 Season Pass
 price is 
$200.00 
($211.81 total*) (over $600 in value!).
By ordering a Pickwick Club season pass, you will receive with our sincere compliments:
A Pickwick Club membership card.
Admission to all 11 days of the 2026 Dickens Christmas Fair (excluding parking), and 10% off all items purchased at the "Patterson & Sons" Fair memorabilia store and other participating locations displaying the Pickwick Club insignia.
Free coat and parcel check.
Experiences
Visitors can enrich their Victorian holiday with epicurean adventures and mysteries to solve in these curated 
Experiences.
Port and Chocolate Tasting
A delicious adventure into the romance and fantasy of Port wine, a true Victorian favorite, paired with 
Bramosia Chocolates
.
Gin Tasting
The dangerous and delicious history of Gin, including 
tastings of different types and a choice of cocktail from one of the selections
.
Jekyll and Hyde Pub Crawl
Solve the mystery and bring Mr. Hyde to justice while imbibing custom designed elixirs at four London pubs.
The Dark Garden Corset Experience
Lace up in luxury with world-renouned corsetiere 
Dark Garden
. Includes complimentary sparkling wine, and store credit. Purchase or simply photograph & dream.
Important Ticket Information:
Tickets are good for any one date of the event of the 2026 season.
In order to control attendance and maintain comfort within the event on busy days, tickets will not be sold on site. 
All tickets must be purchased ONLINE ONLY
. We recommend that you plan to come early in the day and early in the season!
Please be aware that ALL tickets are NON-Refundable
. Although non-refundable, tickets are fully 
transferable
, and can be gifted to any person of your choosing.
Season Passes are not transferable, and must be presented with a photo I.D.
Parking fees are charged at the entrance to the lot by the Cow Palace. The Cow Palace charges $20 per vehicle for parking. (Please email us about large vehicle parking.)
Wheelchairs: The Fair is accessible. Wheelchairs are available for rental at the Cloak and Parcel Check inside the Lower Lobby for $15.00 per half day (4 hours) or $30.00 per full day (4+ hours) on a first-come, first-served basis.
For general questions about the event, please refer to our 
FAQ
 page.
If you still have event or ticket related questions, please email 
[email protected]
.
Legal Bits
Tickets may not be sold for cash on Fair premises. In accepting a ticket, the holder releases Fair owners and management, the Cow Palace, and Agricultural District 1-A, from all liability in the event of accident, property damage, or theft while on Fair premises. Holder grants permission to The Great Dickens Christmas Fair and its agents to utilize ticket holders’ (and their minor children’s) likeness or image incidental to any live or other recording.
Red Barn Productions reserves the right to refuse admittance to any customer not only based on its discretion, but also for health safety or other reasons such the customer being unruly, disrupting the business or its operations, causing injury, stress, or upset to employees, contractors or other customers.
Happy Holidays!
“There is nothing in the world so irresistibly contagious as laughter and good humor.”
~ Charles Dickens, A Christmas Carol

Santa Visits for ALL members of the Family

2026 is our 52nd year
selling trees!
Open in 1974, Santa’s Tree Farm and Village in Half Moon Bay, CA, is a 487-acre Choose-and-Cut Christmas tree farm with 4 different kinds of trees. We give you the saw and send you off to find the perfect tree! Visit Santa’s Village for fun holiday activities. Trees up to 13 feet tall in the field for 2026! Pre-cut trees up to 9 feet tall available in the barn.
Free candy canes and visits with Santa with every tree purchase, while supplies last.

*No Santa Dec. 5th.
Our Trees
Tree cutting Nov. 14 – Dec. 23, rain or shine. Pre-cut trees in barn.
Choose and cut trees up to 13 feet tall, while they last! Five tree species. How will you decide? We can help!

Details
Our Storytelling Festival concludes with a whole lot of tale-spinning!
Tellers from the South Bay Storytellers and Listeners will be joining us to share their 35th annual Tellabration™ event. Join us to listen, or perhaps to contribute a tale, yourself!
This storytelling event targets adults, but school-age children accompanied by an adult are welcome.
Tellabration
™ is worldwide event of storytelling created in 1988 by Connecticut storyteller J.G. Pinkerton. The event brings people together and shares the power and joy of storytelling.
South Bay Storytellers and Listeners are a network of people in Silicon Valley dedicated to making storytelling a vital part of the community. The group hosts the monthly Silicon Valley Storytelling Meetup, now taking place on the 4th Tuesday evening of each month at Menlo Park Library!
This is one of nine events in the 
11th Annual Menlo Park Storytelling Festival
. Join us for one event, or the whole series!

About Storytelling:
Storytelling is telling stories--without using a book.
It's an ancient art form that predates libraries, and books, and writing.
It's not necessarily for children!
Traditional-style storytelling creates unique images in the mind of each listener.
According to the 
National Storytelling Network
, "storytelling is the interactive art of using words and actions to reveal the elements and images of a story while encouraging the listener’s imagination. In storytelling, the listener imagines the story.”
According to the 
Storytelling Association of California
 (an organization dedicated to promoting storytelling as a living art form), storytelling is “orally passing on adventures, wisdom, experiences, surprise, history, laughter, beliefs and imagination.”
